description: Reads the pure text contents of a specific intelligence dossier. Requires an on-chain Base USDC micro-toll payment_proof txHash for full access. Without payment proof, returns a high-fidelity strategic excerpt and payment challenge.

payment_proof.description: Base L2 USDC transaction hash (0x...) verified on-chain as micro-toll proof. Required for full decrypted access.

slug.description: The slug of the dossier to read (e.g., 'sovereign-ai-state-national-policy-2026').

name: read_dossier

text.description: Full dossier text content or Base USDC micro-toll payment challenge JSON.
